## OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE API

OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-gpt-oss-120b-p`. This model supports end-to-end encryption (E2EE) and runs in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). Your prompt is encrypted on your client and decrypted on the GPU within the TEE. The response is then encrypted and sent back to your client for decryption. Venice's system prompt and web search are disabled to preserve end-to-end encryption. Attestation evidence is available for independent verification. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [OpenAI GPT OSS 120B](/models/openai-gpt-oss-120b).

GPT OSS 120B running in a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). OpenAI's open-weight 117B-parameter MoE model with configurable reasoning depth and native tool use, with hardware attestation evidence available for independent verification.

### How to use the OpenAI GPT OSS 120B E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-gpt-oss-120b-p"` and your API key.

This sample sends the prompt as plaintext, so the request runs TEE-only. For end-to-end encryption, send encrypted messages with the E2EE headers, as the [TEE and E2EE guide](/guides/features/tee-e2ee-models#e2ee-models) shows.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-gpt-oss-120b-p",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'
```
